steps.title: Assemble barcoded rabies plasmid
steps.instruction: Digest the rabies cDNA plasmid with SfiI, purify the linearized plasmid, assemble random barcodes by HiFi assembly, and transform into E. coli for colony screening.

substeps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube combine 4 µg plasmid, 10 µL 10× QuickCut Buffer, 5 µL QuickCut SfiI and nuclease‑free water to 100 µL; mix, spin, seal and incubate 50 °C for 3 h.
Add 50 µL DNA‑Clean beads, mix, and purify the linearized plasmid according to the kit (binding, magnetic wash with 80 % ethanol, elution).

In a new 1.5 mL tube combine 2.5 µg purified linear plasmid, 2.5 µL 10 µM ssDNA barcode (15–30 bp overlaps on each end), 50 µL 2× NEBuilder HiFi Master Mix and water to 100 µL; seal and incubate 50 °C for 15–17 h.
Transform 100 ng of the assembly product into chemically competent or electro‑competent E. coli, plate, and pick 10 colonies for Sanger sequencing to verify barcode insertion.

steps.title: Prepare low‑salt LB agar plates
steps.instruction: Make three batches of low‑salt LB agar, autoclave, add ampicillin, pour 15 cm plates and let solidify.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 23 g tryptone, 11.5 g yeast extract, 11.5 g NaCl and 34.5 g agar into a 250 mL glass bottle; invert 10× to mix.
Divide the dry mix equally into three 1 L bottles (24.5 g each), add 700 mL Milli‑Q water, invert gently, autoclave, cool to ~40 °C.
Add 0.7 mL of 100 mg/mL ampicillin stock to each bottle (final 100 µg/mL).
Place thirty 15 cm plates on a clean bench, pour ~70 mL LB per plate, allow to solidify. Keep bottles in a 40 °C water bath until pouring to avoid premature solidification.

steps.title: Electroporate plasmid library
steps.instruction: Electroporate the assembled barcoded plasmid into electrocompetent cells, recover, and plate on low‑salt LB agar.

substeps.instruction: In a 1 mm cuvette add 100 ng purified vector DNA and 25 µL electrocompetent cells; electroporate at 10 µF, 600 Ω, 1800 V.
Immediately add 975 µL recovery medium, transfer to a culture tube and incubate 37 °C, 250 rpm for 1 h.
Plate the entire recovery onto five 15‑cm low‑salt LB agar plates; incubate 37 °C for 15–17 h.
Note: Perform six electroporations total, using thirty 15‑cm plates; expect >30 000 colonies per plate.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid library DNA
steps.instruction: Harvest all colonies, purify endotoxin‑free plasmid DNA, and quantify.

substeps.instruction: Scrape colonies from each plate, weigh wet biomass, and use one endotoxin‑free purification column per 2 g wet biomass.
Elute plasmid, measure concentration with a NanoDrop; aim for ≥1 mg/mL (≈1 mg total yield).

steps.title: Make 1× electrotransfection buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of 1× electrotransfection buffer and filter‑sterilize.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 4.47 g KCl, 0.088 g KH₂PO₄, 0.99 g K₂HPO₄·3H₂O, 2.98 g HEPES, 0.38 g EGTA, 0.55 g Na₂ATP, 0.77 g glutathione; add 75 µL 1 M CaCl₂ and 2.5 mL 1 M MgCl₂; adjust pH to 7 with KOH.
Bring volume to 500 mL with water, pass through a 0.22 µm filter, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make 2× electrotransfection buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL of 2× buffer for use in plasmid‑cell mixtures.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.894 g KCl, 0.0176 g KH₂PO₄, 0.198 g K₂HPO₄·3H₂O, 0.596 g HEPES, 0.076 g EGTA, 0.11 g Na₂ATP, 0.154 g glutathione; add 15 µL 1 M CaCl₂ and 0.5 mL 1 M MgCl₂; adjust pH to 7 with KOH.
Bring to 50 mL, filter through 0.22 µm, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Seed BHK‑EnvA cells (Day ‑1)
steps.instruction: Plate BHK‑EnvA cells for the upcoming electroporation.

substeps.instruction: Culture BHK‑EnvA in high‑glucose DMEM + 10 % FBS.
Seed two 15‑cm dishes with 3.5 × 10⁷ cells per dish.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend cells (Day 0)
steps.instruction: Detach, count, and resuspend BHK‑EnvA cells in ice‑cold electroporation solution.

substeps.instruction: ~14 h after seeding, detach with 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA.
Pellet at 200 × g, 5 min, 4 °C in DMEM + 10 % FBS; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold electroporation solution, count cells.
Transfer 6 × 10⁷ cells to a fresh tube, rinse with 7 mL ice‑cold electroporation solution.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid mixture for rescue
steps.instruction: Combine the seven rescue plasmids with 2× buffer and DMSO to a final volume of 800 µL.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.17 µg pRVΔG, 55.5 µg pCAG‑T7pol, 85 µg pCAG‑B19N, 43.8 µg pCAG‑B19P, 37.5 µg pCAG‑B19L, 45 µg pCAG‑EnvARGCD, 23.5 µg pCAG‑TVA to the tube (amounts per Table 1).
Mix with an equal volume of 2× electrotransfection buffer.
Adjust total volume to 800 µL with ice‑cold buffer and add 10 µL DMSO; mix gently.

steps.title: Electroporate cells with plasmids
steps.instruction: Deliver the plasmid mixture into BHK‑EnvA cells by electroporation and plate the cells.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 800 µL cell‑plasmid suspension into four 4‑mm cuvettes; avoid bubbles (remove with a 200‑µL tip if needed).
Shake cuvettes gently, wipe metal surfaces with dust‑free tissue.
Electroporate using Bio‑Rad: 250 V, 10 pulses, 5 ms each, 1 s interval.
Prepare four 15‑cm dishes each containing 25 mL high‑glucose DMEM + 10 % FBS + 1.25 % DMSO.
Add 200 µL of the electroporated suspension to each dish, gently shake, then add another 200 µL and transfer the remaining volume to the same dish (total ~600 µL per dish).

steps.title: Replace medium (Day 4)
steps.instruction: Rinse and refresh culture medium to remove DMSO.

substeps.instruction: Remove old medium, rinse each plate with 10 mL DPBS.
Add 25 mL fresh high‑glucose DMEM + 10 % FBS (no DMSO).

steps.title: Collect medium Day 6
steps.instruction: Harvest supernatant, replace medium, and filter.

substeps.instruction: Collect 12 mL medium from each plate, replace with 12.5 mL fresh medium.
Filter the collected supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect medium Day 7 and first ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Harvest Day 7 supernatant, treat with benzonase, and concentrate virus by sucrose cushion ultracentrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Collect 12 mL medium from each plate, replace with 12.5 mL fresh medium, filter (0.45 µm).
Pool Day 6 and Day 7 filtrates, add benzonase to 30 U/mL, incubate 37 °C for 30 min with mixing every 10 min.
Prepare three ultracentrifuge tubes each containing 5 mL 20 % (w/v) sucrose in PBS.
Overlay 33 mL pooled virus‑containing medium onto each sucrose cushion (top up to 33 mL if needed).
Balance tubes, ultracentrifuge at 22,000 rpm (82,700 × g), 4 °C for 2 h (Beckman SW32Ti).
Remove supernatant, invert tubes onto dust‑free tissue, drain 5 min, vacuum‑dry residual liquid.
Resuspend each viral pellet in 200 µL DPBS, gently pipette.
Return tubes to 4 °C and shake gently for 15–17 h.

steps.title: Collect medium Day 8 and second ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Harvest remaining supernatant, treat with benzonase, and perform a second sucrose cushion spin (optional overlay for CVS‑N2cΔG).

substeps.instruction: Collect remaining medium, filter (0.45 µm), add benzonase 30 U/mL, incubate 37 °C 30 min.
Prepare fresh tubes with 5 mL 20 % sucrose cushion.
Overlay the Day 8 filtrate plus the Day 7 concentrate (if titer expected <2 × 10⁷) onto the cushion.
Ultracentrifuge again at 22,000 rpm, 4 °C, 2 h.
Remove supernatant, invert, drain 5 min, vacuum‑dry.
Resuspend each pellet in 20 µL DPBS, shake at 4 °C for 15–17 h.

steps.title: Seed HEK‑293 T‑TVA cells (Day 8)
steps.instruction: Plate HEK‑293 T‑TVA cells for viral titration.

substeps.instruction: Seed 1.5 × 10⁵ cells per well into 13 wells of a 24‑well plate.
Add medium to a final volume of 500 µL per well.
Incubate 17–19 h.

steps.title: Aliquot and store virus (Day 9)
steps.instruction: Combine all resuspended virus, aliquot into low‑protein tubes, and freeze.

substeps.instruction: Pool all virus from Day 7 and Day 8 resuspensions, mix gently.
Aliquot 2–3 µL into low‑protein‑binding tubes.
Store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Serially dilute virus for infection
steps.instruction: Prepare a series of 100‑fold dilutions and infect HEK‑293 T‑TVA cells.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3.5 µL virus stock with 350 µL medium → 100× dilution.
Transfer 50 µL of 100× into 450 µL medium → 1,000× dilution.
Transfer 50 µL of 1,000× into 450 µL medium → 10,000× dilution.
Transfer 50 µL of 10,000× into 450 µL medium → 100,000× dilution.
Add 100 µL of each dilution (100×, 1,000×, 10,000×, 100,000×) to three replicate wells per dilution.
Dispense gently to avoid disturbing the monolayer and return plates to the incubator.

steps.title: Count fluorescent clusters (Day 11)
steps.instruction: Identify the dilution yielding 1–10 clusters per 10× field, count clusters, and calculate infectious units per mL.

substeps.instruction: Under a 10× objective, find the dilution with 1–10 fluorescent clusters per field.
For that dilution, count clusters in five fields per well (up, down, left, right, center; each 3.8 mm²).
Collect counts from 15 fields (3 wells × 5 fields).
Remove outliers using a box‑plot method and average the remaining counts (c).
Use the formula IU/mL = 52.1 × c × x, where x is the dilution factor and 52.1 = 52.1 fields per mL (198 mm² well / 3.8 mm² per field).
Adjust the field‑of‑view factor if your microscope differs.

steps.title: First‑round barcode enrichment PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify barcodes from cDNA using PrimeSTAR Max and barcode‑specific primers.

substeps.instruction: In a 100 µL PCR tube combine 60 ng cDNA, 50 µL PrimeSTAR Max, 10 µL 10 µM Barcode‑R, 10 µL 10 µM Barcode‑F, and water to 100 µL.
Run: 98 °C 5 min; 8–10 cycles of 98 °C 30 s, 58 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 12 °C.
Purify product with 1.2× DNA‑Clean beads (set pipette to 100 µL, add water if volume <100 µL).
Elute in 20 µL ultrapure water.

steps.title: Second‑round barcode PCR
steps.instruction: Add adapters and index primers to the first‑round product and amplify.

substeps.instruction: In a new 100 µL tube combine 20 µL first‑round product, 50 µL PrimeSTAR Max, 10 µL 10 µM Adapter‑F, 10 µL 10 µM Index‑R, and water to 100 µL.
Run: 98 °C 5 min; 5–10 cycles of 98 °C 30 s, 52 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 12 °C.
Purify with 1.0× DNA‑Clean beads, elute in 20 µL ultrapure water.
Measure concentration on a NanoDrop (baseline with 1 µL ddH₂O).
Run 4 µL on a gel; expect a ~350 bp band, no ~100 bp primer‑dimer.

steps.title: Assemble spike‑in template DNA
steps.instruction: Create a double‑stranded DNA template containing a T7 promoter for in‑vitro transcription.

substeps.instruction: Synthesize two complementary 15‑bp overlapping ssDNA oligos with a T7 promoter upstream of the forward strand.
In a 20 µL reaction mix 10 µL PrimeSTAR Max, 1 µL 100 µM Spike‑In F, 1 µL 100 µM Spike‑In R, 8 µL water.
PCR: 98 °C 5 min; 50 °C 10 min; 72 °C 5 min; hold 12 °C.
Purify with 1.2× DNA‑Clean beads, elute in 20 µL water, measure concentration on NanoDrop.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcribe spike‑in mRNA
steps.instruction: Generate spike‑in RNA using T7 RNA polymerase and purify.

substeps.instruction: In a 20 µL reaction combine 2 µL 10× T7 Reaction Buffer, 8 µL NTP mix, X µL template DNA, 2 µL RNase Inhibitor, 2 µL T7 RNA Polymerase, water to 20 µL.
Incubate 37 °C for 15–17 h.
Add 80 µL nuclease‑free water and 1 µL DNase I; incubate 37 °C 15 min to remove template DNA.
Purify RNA with TRIzol per manufacturer’s protocol.
Measure RNA concentration on a NanoDrop.

steps.title: Reverse‑transcribe barcode region from input RNA
steps.instruction: Convert input RNA (including spike‑in) to cDNA using gene‑specific RT primers.

substeps.instruction: For each input region, in a tube on ice add 2 µL RNA, 1 µL 10 µM N2c‑RT‑Index, 1 µL 10 mM dNTP mix, 1 µL water (total 4.5 µL). Mix, spin, incubate 65 °C 5 min, chill on ice.
Add 4 µL 5× RT Buffer, 0.5 µL RNase Inhibitor, 0.5 µL Maxima H‑Minus Reverse Transcriptase (total 20 µL).
Incubate 50 °C 20 min, then 85 °C 5 min to terminate.
Take 2 µL from each reaction, pool, store remaining cDNA at –80 °C.
Purify pooled cDNA with 1.2× DNA‑Clean beads; store at –20 °C (pause point).

steps.title: Pre‑amplify input cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform PCR on pooled cDNA to amplify barcode‑linked fragments.

substeps.instruction: In a 25 µL PCR mix add 10 µL RT‑PCR product, 5 µL 10 µM Barcode‑linker‑F, 5 µL 10 µM Linker1st‑R, and water to 25 µL.
PCR: 98 °C 5 min; 10–15 cycles of 98 °C 30 s, 58 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 12 °C.
Remove 4 µL for gel check; adjust total volume to 16 µL (add water if <16 µL).
Purify with 1.2× DNA beads (19.2 µL beads), elute in 20 µL water.
Measure concentration on NanoDrop; run gel (expect ~270 bp band, no ~100 bp dimer).

steps.title: Index PCR of input libraries
steps.instruction: Add Illumina adapters and indexes to the pre‑amplified input libraries.

substeps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine X µL (20 ng) pre‑amp product, 5 µL 10 µM Adapter‑F, 5 µL 10 µM Index‑R, 25 µL PrimeSTAR Max, and water to 50 µL.
PCR: 98 °C 5 min; 5–10 cycles of 98 °C 30 s, 52 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 12 °C.
Purify with 1.0× DNA beads (20 µL beads), elute in 20 µL water.
Measure concentration on NanoDrop; run gel (expect ~330 bp band, no ~100 bp dimer).

description: This protocol outlines a complete workflow for the one-step production of high-diversity barcoded EnvA-pseudotyped rabies viruses, specifically SAD-B19ΔG and CVS-N2cΔG, followed by their application in the Barcoded Rabies Viral Tracing (BRT) method. Successful implementation relies on specific biological systems for both virus production and in vivo tracing. For virus generation, this protocol utilizes BHK-EnVA packaging cell lines expressing EnVA to ensure efficient amplification of the viral library.3,4 For the in vivo application, the protocol employs AAV helper viruses encoding the avian receptor (TVA) and rabies N2c-glycoprotein (N2cG) to genetically define starter populations within the mouse brain. While this protocol specifically describes mapping connectivity of mPFC neurons, the BRT method described here is adaptable to other brain regions and specific cell types where starter cells can be genetically targeted.
